title.en: Weigh the benefits and limitations of organic farming

say.en: Chemical fertilisers and pesticides raised yields, but they also harmed soil, water and health. Can farmers grow enough food while protecting the land for their grandchildren? In this lesson: Define sustainable development.
Explain organic farming.
Weigh the benefits and limitations of organic farming.

body.en: *Sustainable development* meets the needs of the present generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs. Organic farming is a whole system of farming that restores, maintains and enhances the ecological balance. It uses organic inputs such as compost, farmyard manure, bio-fertilisers and biological pest control instead of synthetic fertilisers and pesticides.
body.kn: ಸುಸ್ಥಿರ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡದೆ ಇಂದಿನ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕಗಳ ಬದಲು ಕಾಂಪೋಸ್ಟ್, ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಕೀಟ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಬಳಸಿ ಪರಿಸರ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಕಾಪಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: *Benefits*: organic farming replaces costly agro-inputs with cheaper locally produced organic inputs; it earns income from exports, as demand for organic food is growing; its food is healthier and free of chemical residues; and it is labour intensive, so it creates rural employment. Limitations: yields are often lower in the early years; it needs awareness and support for farmers; small and marginal farmers find it hard to switch; organic produce may have a shorter shelf life and less choice in the off-season. Sikkim became India's first fully organic state in 2016.
body.kn: ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿ ಅಗ್ಗದ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಪರಿಕರ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ, ರಫ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ತರುತ್ತದೆ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಆಹಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಆರಂಭದ ಇಳುವರಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಸಣ್ಣ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದು ಕಷ್ಟ. 2016 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಂ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸಾವಯವ ರಾಜ್ಯವಾಯಿತು.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. On one acre, chemical farming gives 20 quintals sold at ₹2,000 a quintal, with costs of ₹25,000. Organic farming gives 16 quintals sold at a 30% premium, with costs of ₹18,000. Compare profits. (Illustrative figures.)

say.en: Let us work this out together. On one acre, chemical farming gives 20 quintals sold at 2,000 rupees a quintal, with costs of 25,000 rupees. Organic farming gives 16 quintals sold at a 30 percent premium, with costs of 18,000 rupees. Compare profits. Illustrative figures.
Chemical: revenue equals 20 times 2,000 equals 40,000 rupees; profit equals 40,000 minus 25,000 equals 15,000 rupees.
Organic price equals 2,000 times 1.3 equals 2,600 rupees a quintal; revenue equals 16 times 2,600 equals 41,600 rupees.
Organic profit equals 41,600 minus 18,000 equals 23,600 rupees.
Organic earns more here despite the lower yield, because costs are lower and the price is higher.
So the answer is Chemical 15,000 rupees; organic 23,600 rupees.

say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಸುಸ್ಥಿರ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡದೆ ಇಂದಿನ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಪೂರೈಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Organic farming uses compost, manure and natural pest control, not chemicals.
say.kn: ಸಾವಯವ ಕೃಷಿ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕಗಳ ಬದಲು ಕಾಂಪೋಸ್ಟ್, ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ನೈಸರ್ಗಿಕ ಕೀಟ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Benefits: cheaper inputs, exports, healthier food, more jobs.
say.kn: ಲಾಭಗಳು: ಅಗ್ಗದ ಪರಿಕರ, ರಫ್ತು, ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಆಹಾರ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಉದ್ಯೋಗ.

say.en: Limits: lower early yields and shorter shelf life.
say.kn: ಮಿತಿಗಳು: ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇಳುವರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಬೇಗ ಹಾಳಾಗುವಿಕೆ.
